game_concept: A racing platformer set in Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove, a tidepool cove: the dock cartographer must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Gatekeeper If: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors.
theme: Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove: a tidepool cove
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: State tracing: Trace ACC after every instruction. subtract 5 from each value. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 1, operand 5.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Gatekeeper If' (Week 3 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Tidepool Cove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the lighthouse lamp by solving code steps involving gate_integrity that move the dock cartographer forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.6).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the lighthouse lamp first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
